title: HostCover Terms: Escalation Timing on Income-Loss Claims
content:
Under **Host Damage Protection (HostCover)**, the income escalation share follows the calendar days from the date part of the guest's response deadline to the date part of the host's escalation of the income-loss claim: an escalation 22 to 30 days after the deadline settles the lost income at 85 percent, one 8 to 21 days after at 95 percent, and one 7 days or fewer after in full. The percentage applies to the lost income being settled, before any guest payment or deductible comes off it.

## Day-count illustration (hypothetical deadline at 14:00 on 28 February 2026)

Counting runs in calendar days from 28 February:

- escalation on 7 March 2026: 7 days, in full;
- escalation on 8 March 2026: 8 days, 95 percent;
- escalation on 21 March 2026: 21 days, 95 percent;
- escalation on 22 March 2026: 22 days, 85 percent;
- escalation on 30 March 2026: 30 days, 85 percent.

| Days | Lost income settled at |
|---|---|
| 7 or fewer | in full |
| 8 to 21 | 95 percent |
| 22 to 30 | 85 percent |

Lost income of 2000.00 escalated 22 days after the deadline date enters the settlement at 1700.00.
